entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: Llanowar elf warrior known for his time aboard the Weatherlight; studied Maro-Sorcery under Multani and was killed by Gallowbraid.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Living forest whose voice Rofellos briefly became.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Forest guardian of Yavimaya who taught Rofellos Maro-Sorcery.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Weatherlight captain and fellow pupil of Multani.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: Fellow pupil of Multani who joined the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Person whose family's estate was attacked.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Coming invasion for which Yavimaya's defenses were built.

events.summary: Rofellos is sent to Yavimaya and exchanges places with Multani as the voice of the forest.
events.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as the voice of Yavimaya

events.summary: Rofellos steps down as Yavimaya's avatar; Multani offers to teach him Maro-Sorcery.
Rofellos studies with Gerrard and Mirri under Multani, then joins the Weatherlight crew with Mirri.
events.quote: Rofellos and Mirri offered to come along as well

events.summary: Gallowbraid murders Rofellos during the attack on Crovax's Estate; his death drives Gerrard to leave the Weatherlight.

relations.quote: Multani offered to teach him the secrets of Maro-Sorcery.
